questions.question: How do I log in to iThenticate?
questions.answer: To log in to iThenticate, open www.ithenticate.com, click the Login button, and then enter your university email address and password (the activation password is sent to you via iThenticate).

questions.question: What file types can I submit to iThenticate?
questions.answer: You can submit Word, Text, PostScript, PDF, HTML, Excel, PowerPoint, Word Perfect (WPD), OpenOffice (ODT), RTF, and Hangul (HWP) files.

questions.question: How big can a file be when I submit it to iThenticate?
questions.answer: A file submitted to iThenticate must be less than 100 MB in size.
